title: Scripted Wakeup and Closeout — reduce agent-level calls and permission friction
summary: WAI wakeup and closeout involve many sequential agent calls (file reads, git status, teaching discovery, lug scanning). Wakeup part addressed by syncing wai.md pre-check (trusts session-start hook output, skips redundant file reads). Remaining: closeout-collect.sh that handles mechanical steps so agent only does semantic work.
why_bother: Every wakeup requires the agent to make 8-12 individual file reads. A shell script runs all at once and delivers a single briefing — faster, fewer interruptions. For closeout, 10+ mechanical file edits (version bump, state update, lug archival, index regen) can be scripted leaving AI only for semantic decisions (signal extraction, next_session_recommendation).
goal: closeout-collect.sh produces a prepared bundle; agent reads, provides semantic inputs (next_rec, signals), confirms commit. Wakeup already addressed via wai.md pre-check.
problem: Session at 21% context after wakeup due to redundant file reads. Closeout takes ~15 AI tool calls for mechanical operations.
expected_value: Wakeup: messages tokens drop from ~22k to ~5-8k. Closeout: tool calls drop from ~15 to ~5.
scope: tools/closeout.sh: version bump, WAI-State.json field updates (session_count++, last_closeout, last_modified_at/by), lug archival (in_progress→completed), WAI-LugIndex.jsonl regen, score_backlog.py run, git status report
templates/commands/wai-closeout.md: update to call tools/closeout.sh, remove mechanical steps from AI flow
DONE: templates/commands/wai.md pre-check already present; synced to .claude/commands/wai.md
acceptance_criteria: tools/closeout.sh is idempotent — safe to re-run
Script handles: version bump, WAI-State.json updates, lug routing/archival, index regen, backlog scoring

All existing closeout behavior preserved (no regressions)
constraints: Scripts must be idempotent (safe to re-run)
Agent still owns final confirmation gate (no silent commits)
Scripts run with existing permissions — no new sudo/elevated access
Compatible with all WAI agent types (Claude, Gemini, Copilot)
